inclusion_rule: Radar or RF silent-speech and speech recognition studies (same population as M05 rf-articulator-sensing-placement, plus papers whose text mentions RF or FMCW sensing); the design compared is the output: a class label from a closed list of vowels, words, commands or sentences, versus a variable-length token sequence decoded into words and scored by WER.
